# AmigaNLoad

Compact open-source Windows video/audio downloader, formerly published as Downloading.
Version 3.2. Uses yt-dlp. Windows 10/11. GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Windows downloads
- Setup: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop/releases/latest/download/AmigaNLoad-Setup.exe
- Portable ZIP: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop/releases/latest/download/AmigaNLoad-Portable.zip

The latest release contains only these two downloadable packages. The Portable ZIP contains the executable and required image assets only.

## Features
- Link paste and media metadata preview
- Video quality: Best, 1080p, 720p, 480p
- Audio: MP3 320 kbps or best original audio
- Estimated file size, progress percentage and transfer speed
- Custom output folder
- Three-item recent history, retry and open downloaded file
- Optional browser-session authentication for detected local profiles

## Requirements and limitations
- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- FFmpeg is optional and not bundled; some merging and MP3 conversion tasks require it.
- Website support depends on yt-dlp and changes over time.
- Use only for content the user is legally allowed to download.
- Published Windows executables are unsigned.
